name: Bio Run Tracker
description: Posts each level run (start% -> end%) to a local updater that live-updates your Discord bio.

tracked_level_ids.name: Tracked Level IDs
tracked_level_ids.description: Comma-separated level IDs to track (e.g. 128 or 128,4284). Blank = track every level. Find a level's ID on its info page.

server_id.name: Server ID
server_id.description: Blank = your global (About Me) bio. Enter a guild id to update that one server's bio instead (needs Nitro).

discord_token.name: Discord Token
discord_token.description: Your Discord user token. Per-server bio needs Nitro. Update it here when it expires.

updater_url.name: Updater URL
updater_url.description: Where the bio-updater is listening. Default matches the Node updater on this PC.

enabled_tracking.name: Track runs
enabled_tracking.description: Turn run posting on/off without disabling the mod.
